instruction: I want to disable remote content in emails for better privacy and security. Can you configure Thunderbird to block remote content by default?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling remote content in emails for privacy. The evaluator checks if mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image preference is set to true. Standard Thunderbird preference with similar complexity to original theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses the correct Thunderbird preference 'mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image' for blocking remote content in emails
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird window before reading preferences, ensuring settings are flushed to disk
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js file and validates boolean values using json.loads()
Expected value 'true' correctly represents disabled remote images, matching the instruction requirement
Complete instruction coverage: single requirement (disable remote content) is fully verified
Appropriate all-or-nothing scoring for a single boolean preference setting
Handles edge cases: returns 0.0 if file is None, robust regex parsing

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
